messages:
olivia: Heads-up — post-deploy smoke sweep just tripped on eu-canary. p50 token latency jumped ~32ms -> ~220ms around 1769754200. deploy-bot posted an alert. should we hold the next wave?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] synth-check: p50 latency > 3x baseline for 5m on model-embed-eu1. run_id=run-2026-03-21-09:03. samples attached.

raj: on it, pulling traces and kv cache metrics now.

maria: can you paste the synth output? curious if it's prefix-heavy or small tokens.

deploy-bot: ```
# synth sample (truncated)
2026-03-21T09:02:10Z p50=220ms p95=480ms sample=embed-request prefix_len=64 model=model-embed-eu1
2026-03-21T09:03:05Z p50=210ms p95=450ms sample=embed-request prefix_len=8 model=model-embed-eu1
```

sre-oncall: initial glance -> KV cache miss ratio spiked at the same time in eu1. Could be prefill not firing or warmup jitter. no GC spikes on hosts tho.

enginella: logs show a small host got a transient socket backlog at 09:01 but CPU and memory normal. might be connection storm while kvcache warmed.

jamal: my vote: pin traffic back to previous model variant (v2.3.1) for eu-canary and hold next rollout. minimize customer impact while we root cause.

maria: +1 to pin. also recommend starting a targeted synthetic that stresses prefix-heavy workloads to validate kvcache behavior after pin.

olivia: decision: pin eu-canary to model v2.3.1 and hold. i've annotated the rollout and paused the next wave. @deploy-bot please apply pin and set an audit note. i'll add to release notes.

deploy-bot: Action: traffic pinned to model-embed-eu1@v2.3.1 for canary (applied by Olivia). pin_id=pin-6162. TTL_override=60s. Audit: "postdeploy p50 spike; pin and hold for triage". Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/synth/run-2026-03-21-09-03

raj: spinning up the heavy-prefix synthetic now (config below). will report p50s in 5m.

jamal: if the heavy-prefix test stays high, we should consider increasing prefill concurrency or staging a quick hotfix. if it normalizes, unpin after 10m of stability.

raj: ```
# quick kvcache prefill synthetic
curl -X POST https://synth-run.local/run -d '{"test":"embed","prefix_len":128,"rate":5}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SYNTH_KEY'
```

maria: starting the test now. tagging observability: @sre-oncall for watch. marking incident sev=3.

sre-oncall: watching metrics. if p50 stays < 1.5x baseline for 10m we'll consider unpin. otherwise we'll rollback to v2.3.1 across canary lanes and schedule a hotpatch.

olivia: thanks team — i'll update the release notes + change window. keep chatter here, and i'll close thread if stable after the watch window. :thumbsup:
